598: ## 6. Kconfig 和 defconfig 方案
599: 
600: ### 6.1 芯片 Kconfig
601: 
602: 建议：
603: 
604: ```kconfig
605: config BK7258_SDIO
606: 	bool "BK7258 SDIO host"
607: 	select ARCH_HAVE_SDIO
608: 	select SDIO_BLOCKSETUP
609: 	help
610: 		Enable the BK7258 SDIO host lower-half for the AP core.
611: 
612: config BK7258_SDIO_DMA
613: 	bool "BK7258 SDIO DMA"
614: 	depends on BK7258_SDIO
615: 	select SDIO_DMA
616: 	help
617: 		Enable only after PIO, DMA reachability and cache handling are verified.
618: ```
619: 
620: DMA 阶段只有在实现 `dmapreflight()` 后才选择 `ARCH_HAVE_SDIO_PREFLIGHT`。
621: 
622: ### 6.2 首版 defconfig
623: 
624: 建议起始配置：
625: 
626: ```text
627: CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO=y
628: # CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO_DMA is not set
629: 
630: CONFIG_MMCSD=y
631: CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIO=y
632: # CONFIG_MMCSD_SPI is not set
633: CONFIG_MMCSD_NSLOTS=1
634: CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1
635: # CONFIG_MMCSD_MMCSUPPORT is not set
636: # CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_CARDDETECT is not set
637: # CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_WRITEPROTECT is not set
638: # CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIOWAIT_WRCOMPLETE is not set
639: 
640: CONFIG_SDIO_BLOCKSETUP=y
641: # CONFIG_SDIO_DMA is not set
642: 
643: CONFIG_SCHED_HPWORK=y
644: 
645: CONFIG_FS_FAT=y
646: CONFIG_NSH_MMCSDMINOR=0
647: 
648: CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD=y
649: CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_ERROR=y
650: CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_WARN=y
651: CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_INFO=y
652: ```
653: 
654: 说明：
655: 
656: - `CONFIG_SCHED_HPWORK` 满足 MMCSD media callback/work queue 依赖，即使固定介质不发生插拔。
657: - `CONFIG_FS_FAT` 对应 NuttX 原生 `vfat`，不是 Armino 的 `CONFIG_FATFS`。
658: - `CONFIG_FSUTILS_MKFATFS` 首轮可以不启用，避免误格式化；进入受控格式化测试阶段再启用。
659: - `CONFIG_MMCSD_MMCSUPPORT` 首版关闭，避免无必要的 MMC/eMMC probe 和 EXT_CSD 分区路径。
660: - 若日志量影响时序，稳定后关闭 `CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_INFO`，保留 error/warn 和 driver counters。
661: 
662: ### 6.3 分区配置
663: 
664: 先读取 sector 0，再选择一种路径：
665: 
666: | 介质布局 | 识别特征 | OpenVela 路径 |
667: | --- | --- | --- |
668: | FAT superfloppy | sector 0 是 FAT BPB/boot sector | 直接 mount `/dev/mmcsd0` |
669: | MBR + FAT | offset `0x1fe` 为 `0x55aa`，有有效 MBR partition entry | 开 `CONFIG_MBR_PARTITION`，注册 `/dev/mmcsd0p0` |
670: | GPT + FAT | protective MBR，LBA1 有 `EFI PART` | 开 `CONFIG_GPT_PARTITION`，注册 GPT partition |
671: | 未格式化/未知 | 无合法 BPB/MBR/GPT | 不自动写入，转人工确认和受控格式化 |
672: 
673: NuttX 不会自动把 MBR 分区注册成 `/dev/mmcsd0pN`。板级应使用 `parse_block_partition()` 和自定义 handler：
674: 
675: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/fs/partition.h:49-83`
676: - `openvela/nuttx/boards/risc-v/mpfs/common/src/mpfs_emmcsd.c:47-79`
677: 
678: ## 7. 分阶段实施
679: 
680: ### 阶段 S0：硬件和 golden 固件取证
681: 
682: 目标：在修改 OpenVela 前固定当前 1 GB 板的事实。
683: 
684: 操作：
685: 
686: 1. 使用未修改的 `bk_solution_ai` golden AP 固件挂载 SD-NAND。
687: 2. 记录 GPIO52 电平、SDCLK 上电时序、ID clock 和 transfer clock。
688: 3. 导出 CMD8、ACMD41 OCR、CID、CSD、RCA、card type 和容量。
689: 4. 读取 sector 0、LBA1 和 FAT BPB，但不写介质。
690: 5. 记录 FAT volume label、总容量、free space、cluster size 和现有文件 hash。
691: 6. 确认板型原理图中的 GPIO14..19、LDO GPIO、有效电平、外部 pull-up 和 rail sharing。
692: 7. 确认 CPU0/CP 没有同时初始化或访问 SDIO。
693: 
694: 交付物：
695: 
696: - 当前板型硬件连接表。
697: - golden CID/CSD/OCR 和 sector 0 dump。
698: - golden SDCLK 频率与命令时序。
699: - 数据备份和 hash 清单。
700: 
701: 退出条件：
702: 
703: - 1 GB 容量来自实测而不是参考文档。
704: - 明确 superfloppy、MBR 或 GPT。
705: - 明确电源 rail 和 GPIO，不再依赖 GPIO52 假设。
706: 
707: ### 阶段 S1：PWC 时钟和寄存器可访问性
708: 
709: 目标：保证 CPU1 在每次 Host 配置前已经获得 SDIO clock。
710: 
711: 操作：
712: 
713: 1. 核对 CP 对 `CLK_PWR_ID_SDIO` 的 command ID、参数和 completion 语义。
714: 2. 在现有 Mailbox/PWC 层增加同步 clock request helper。
715: 3. 使用有限超时等待 ACK/completion 或可靠寄存器 readback。
716: 4. 开钟后读取 SDIO register 默认值/version；关钟后验证 gate 状态。
717: 5. 所有失败均返回负 errno，不用固定延时后假定成功。
718: 
719: 退出条件：
720: 
721: - 连续冷启动 100 次均能确定 clock request 成功或明确超时。
722: - clock 未就绪时不会继续初始化 SDIO。
723: - 不影响现有 heartbeat、PWC ready、日志和 PWM。
724: 
725: ### 阶段 S2：寄存器、GPIO、IRQ 和命令层
726: 
727: 目标：完成 lower-half 的 reset、clock、attach、sendcmd、waitresponse 和 response reader。
728: 
729: 操作：
730: 
731: 1. 定义 secure base `0x458d0000` 和经核对的 register bits。
732: 2. 定义 external IRQ10/NuttX IRQ26。
733: 3. 配置 GPIO14/15/16 为 CLK/CMD/DAT0，固定介质上电后满足器件延时。
734: 4. 实现 ID clock 和 20 MHz clock 切换。
735: 5. 实现 command complete、response timeout、CRC error 和 R1/R2/R3/R6/R7 读取。
736: 6. 在 host constructor 内建立 semaphore/watchdog/event 状态并完成 reset。
737: 7. 用临时 debug counters 记录每类 IRQ 和错误，不在 ISR 大量打印。
738: 
739: 调试顺序：
740: 
741: ```text
742: CMD0 无响应
743:   -> CMD8 R7 = 0x1aa
744:   -> CMD55 R1 APP_CMD bit
745:   -> ACMD41 R3 OCR ready
746:   -> CMD2 R2 CID
747:   -> CMD3 R6 RCA
748:   -> CMD9 R2 CSD
749: ```
750: 
751: 退出条件：
752: 
753: - CMD8 和 OCR 与 golden 一致。
754: - CID/CSD 连续复位读取稳定。
755: - 拔掉/断开 SD-NAND 或关闭 rail 时，命令在有限时间内返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`，不死锁。
756: - IRQ26 只由 SDIO 触发，不影响其他中断。
757: 
758: ### 阶段 S3：PIO 单块数据和 `/dev/mmcsd0`
759: 
760: 目标：实现 512 字节单块 PIO 数据传输并由 NuttX 注册块设备。
761: 
762: 操作：
763: 
764: 1. 实现 `blocksetup`、`recvsetup`、`sendsetup`、`cancel`、`waitenable`、`eventwait`。
765: 2. RX/TX PIO 按 FIFO ready 和剩余字节数搬运，处理非 4-byte 对齐尾部。
766: 3. 正确映射 data timeout、CRC fail、FIFO underflow/overflow 和 transfer end。
767: 4. `bk7258_sdio_initialize(0)` 返回完整 `sdio_dev_s`。
768: 5. 板级调用 `mmcsd_slotinitialize(0, dev)`。
769: 6. 保持 `CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1`。
770: 7. 只读执行 geometry、sector 0 dump 和全盘抽样 hash。
771: 
772: 退出条件：
773: 
774: - `/dev/mmcsd0` 稳定出现。
775: - `BIOC_GEOMETRY` 报告 512-byte sector 和正确容量级别。
776: - sector 0 与 golden dump 完全一致。
777: - 连续读取、随机读取和未对齐用户 buffer 测试不产生 CRC/data error。
778: - timeout/cancel 后下一条命令仍可执行，无需整机复位。
779: 
780: ### 阶段 S4：分区识别和 FAT32 挂载
781: 
782: 目标：无损挂载已有文件系统。
783: 
784: 操作：
785: 
786: 1. 根据 S0 结果决定直接设备或分区设备。
787: 2. 创建 `/mnt/sdnand`。
788: 3. 以 NuttX `vfat` 挂载，不使用 Armino `fatfs` mount 参数。
789: 4. 首次挂载只读或仅执行读取操作。
790: 5. 比对目录、文件大小和 hash。
791: 6. 之后进行受控小文件 create/write/fsync/read/rename/unlink 测试。
792: 7. 每次破坏性测试前备份并确保介质未被 USB MSC 或其他核同时访问。
793: 
794: 退出条件：
795: 
796: - 现有 FAT32 可重复挂载和卸载。
797: - golden 文件 hash 一致。
798: - `fsync()`、`sync()`、unmount 后重新上电数据仍一致。
799: - 不存在 OpenVela 和 PC USB mass-storage 同时写同一 FAT 卷的场景。
800: 
801: ### 阶段 S5：多块传输和可靠性
802: 
803: 目标：解除单块限制并验证标准 CMD18/CMD25/CMD12 生命周期。
804: 
805: 操作：
806: 
807: 1. 移除或增大 `CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT`。
808: 2. 测试 2、4、8、32、128 sectors 连续读写。
809: 3. 验证 CMD12、R1b busy、写完成和后续 CMD13/card state。
810: 4. 对读写方向切换、非连续 LBA、超时和 CRC 注入执行恢复测试。
811: 5. 运行 FAT 文件压力测试和大文件 hash。
812: 
813: 退出条件：
814: 
815: - 多块性能高于单块且无数据差异。
816: - 10,000 次随机块操作无永久死锁、越界写和 silent corruption。
817: - 任意一次错误后可通过 cancel/reset 恢复，或明确返回需要重枚举。
818: 
819: ### 阶段 S6：4-bit 模式
820: 
821: 目标：启用 DAT1..3 并提高吞吐量。
822: 
823: 操作：
824: 
825: 1. 从原理图确认 GPIO17..19 和 pull-up。
826: 2. 确认 GPIO18/19 不再承担 PWM/LCD 等冲突功能。
827: 3. lower-half capabilities 改为 `SDIO_CAPS_4BIT`。
828: 4. 由 NuttX 上层发送 ACMD6 后，`widebus(true)` 切 Host 为 4-bit。
829: 5. 先保持 20 MHz，不同时提升频率。
830: 6. 重跑所有错误恢复、压力和掉电测试。
831: 
832: 退出条件：
833: 
834: - 逻辑分析仪确认 DAT0..3 均有活动。
835: - 4-bit 吞吐显著提升，CRC error 不高于 1-bit 基线。
836: - 低温、低压或长时间压力条件下无新增错误。
837: 
838: ### 阶段 S7：DMA，可选
839: 
840: 目标：在 PIO 已稳定后降低 CPU 占用。
841: 
842: 前置事实：当前 OpenVela AP RAM MPU 为 non-cacheable，首版没有 D-cache coherency 问题，但 DMA master 的 DTCM/SRAM/PSRAM 可达性和 alignment 仍须实测。AVDK dormant DMA 路径把 endpoint 固定声明为 DTCM 且缺少完整 cache maintenance，不能直接照搬。
843: 
844: 操作：
845: 
846: 1. 确认 DMA request mux、方向、FIFO 地址和 IRQ。
847: 2. 建立 DMA 可访问内存范围和最小 alignment。
848: 3. 实现 `dmarecvsetup`、`dmasendsetup` 和 `dmapreflight`。
849: 4. 对不满足条件的 buffer 返回 `-EFAULT`，使用 bounce buffer 或 `CONFIG_FAT_DIRECT_RETRY`。
850: 5. TX 在 DMA 前 clean，RX 在 DMA 后 invalidate；即使当前 non-cacheable，也保留未来 cache enable 的明确策略。
851: 6. 只有实现 preflight 后才上报 `SDIO_CAPS_DMASUPPORTED`。
852: 
853: 退出条件：
854: 
855: - 任意 4/8/16/32-byte alignment 测试均通过或按设计走 bounce/retry。
856: - DMA 和 PIO hash 一致。
857: - PSRAM、SRAM、DTCM buffer 的支持/拒绝行为有明确测试结果。
858: - CPU 占用下降且吞吐提升，无 cache corruption。
859: 
860: ## 8. 文件系统和数据安全策略
861: 
862: ### 8.1 首次接入只读
863: 
864: 首次 NuttX 枚举后只执行：
865: 
866: - `BIOC_GEOMETRY`。
867: - sector 0、LBA1、末尾附近 sector 的读取。
868: - FAT mount 后 `ls`、读取和 hash。
869: 
870: 禁止执行：
871: 
872: - `mkfatfs`。
873: - `dd` 写入整盘。
874: - block driver destructive test。
875: - 自动 fsck 修复。
876: - 自动格式化 fallback。
877: 
878: ### 8.2 格式化策略
879: 
880: 只有以下条件全部满足时才允许格式化：
881: 
882: 1. 已完成整盘备份。
883: 2. 已确认介质布局不再需要兼容 PC/原厂固件的既有分区。
884: 3. 介质已卸载且 USB MSC 未导出。
885: 4. 使用明确设备节点，不通过模糊路径选择。
886: 5. 操作由开发者显式触发，不由 boot bring-up 自动执行。
887: 
888: 需要时启用：
889: 
890: ```text
891: CONFIG_FSUTILS_MKFATFS=y
892: ```
893: 
894: 格式化工具依据：
895: 
896: - `openvela/apps/fsutils/mkfatfs/mkfatfs.c:121-209`
897: - `openvela/apps/fsutils/mkfatfs/mkfatfs.c:244-334`
898: 
899: ### 8.3 多主机互斥
900: 
901: 参考文档说明 PC 可通过 USB 读写 SD-NAND。这通常意味着设备可能被导出为 USB Mass Storage。FAT 不支持两个独立主机同时读写同一卷。
902: 
903: 正式产品必须固定所有权状态机：
904: 
905: ```text
906: OpenVela mounted
907:   -> USB MSC 不可导出或只读
908: 
909: 切换到 USB MSC
910:   -> sync
911:   -> unmount
912:   -> block cache flush/transfer stop
913:   -> 再把设备交给 USB
914: 
915: USB eject/disconnect
916:   -> 重新枚举或确认 media state
917:   -> 再由 OpenVela mount
918: ```
919: 
920: 第一阶段不实现 USB MSC，只确保没有其他核或 PC 同时访问。
921: 
922: ### 8.4 掉电一致性
923: 
924: 板载 NAND 有内部 FTL 和写缓存的可能。普通 FAT `fsync()` 只能保证数据写到块设备请求边界，不能证明 NAND 内部电源故障安全。
925: 
926: 验收应包含：
927: 
928: - 写文件后 `fsync()`，再 unmount 和正常断电。
929: - 写入中随机断电，重启后检查文件系统和旧文件完整性。
930: - CMD12/CMD13/R1b busy 完成后再关闭 LDO。
931: - power key 路径先执行 storage quiesce，再请求系统掉电。
932: - 若器件 datasheet 规定 power-off busy time，按其最大值执行。
933: 
934: 在没有器件型号和 datasheet 前，不声称具备掉电不丢数据能力。
935: 
936: ## 9. 错误处理和可观测性
937: 
938: ### 9.1 errno 映射
939: 
940: 建议统一：
941: 
942: | 硬件/协议错误 | lower-half 返回或 event |
943: | --- | --- |
944: | command/response timeout | `-ETIMEDOUT` |
945: | response CRC/index error | `-EIO` |
946: | data CRC/FIFO error | `SDIOWAIT_ERROR`，上层转 `-EIO` |
947: | data timeout | `SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT` |
948: | unsupported response/path | `-ENOSYS` 或 `-EINVAL` |
949: | DMA buffer 不可达/未对齐 | `-EFAULT` |
950: | clock/PWC 未就绪 | `-ETIMEDOUT` 或底层明确错误 |
951: | 介质未成功枚举 | `-ENODEV` |
952: 
953: 所有 wait 必须有有限超时；任何错误路径都要能 cancel、清 pending、释放 semaphore/mutex 并允许后续恢复。
954: 
955: ### 9.2 驱动统计
956: 
957: 建议保留低成本 counters，可通过 debug API 或 procfs 输出：
958: 
959: ```text
960: cmd_count
961: cmd_timeout
962: cmd_crc_error
963: rx_blocks
964: tx_blocks
965: data_timeout
966: data_crc_error
967: fifo_error
968: cancel_count
969: host_reset_count
970: power_cycle_count
971: last_cmd
972: last_status
973: last_error
974: ```
975: 
976: ISR 内不打印逐块日志。高频日志会改变 FIFO/IRQ 时序，并继续占用当前 Mailbox UART transport。
977: 
978: ### 9.3 已知源码风险
979: 
980: 移植时必须显式处理，不照搬：
981: 
982: - AVDK 生成寄存器头中的旧 base 注释和 CRC bit shift 冲突。
983: - FIFO/state reset 的 active level 注释互相矛盾。
984: - AVDK LL 的时钟寄存器地址存在 secure absolute address 硬编码。
985: - AVDK AP GPIO map 检查 `CONFIG_PIN_SDIO_GROUP_0`，而 Kconfig 使用 group 1 命名。
986: - 原厂 PIO TX 把任意 buffer 强转为 `uint32_t *`，未完整处理 alignment。

# 1. What the existing BK7258 AVDK code actually does

## 1.1 It already defaults to non-DMA, but is not a NuttX lower-half

The BK7258 AP AVDK configuration has:

- SD card and SDIO host enabled.
- SDIO v2 enabled.
- GDMA disabled.
- One-bit mode selected.

See:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:328-346`

In particular:

```text
CONFIG_SDCARD_BUSWIDTH_4LINE=n
CONFIG_SDIO_4LINES_EN=n
CONFIG_SDIO_GDMA_EN=n
CONFIG_SDIO_HOST=y
```

The AVDK Kconfig makes DMA and four-line mode independent options:

- GDMA depends on `SDIO_V2P0 && GENERAL_DMA`:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio/Kconfig:42-45`
- Four-line mode depends only on SDIO:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio/Kconfig:52-55`

Likewise, the host configuration stores bus width and TX/RX DMA enable as independent fields:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/sdio_host_types.h:42-47`

This is strong evidence that **4-bit operation is not technically dependent on DMA**.

## 1.2 Current “PIO” is mostly thread-polling plus block-end IRQs

The current v2 driver is not truly FIFO-interrupt-driven PIO.

At initialization it writes interrupt mask `0xe03f`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:445-449`

That enables command and data terminal conditions in bits 0–5, but does **not** enable:

- RX FIFO need-read, bit 6
- TX FIFO need-write, bit 7
- RX overflow, bit 8
- TX empty, bit 9

Those conditions and masks are defined at:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:91-117`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:119-141`

Consequently:

- FIFO words are moved by the calling thread, using readiness polling.
- The SDIO IRQ is mainly used to post semaphores at command completion or block/data completion.
- RX/TX FIFO watermark interrupts are present in hardware but effectively unused by the current host PIO path.

A native NuttX `recvsetup()` cannot use this exact model because it is called **before the read command**; the data must later be drained asynchronously while the upper half waits in `eventwait()`.

# 2. Registers, widths, FIFO state, and interrupt conditions

## 2.1 Register base and IRQ

The AVDK AP uses secure SDIO base:

```text
0x458d0000
```

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:123-126`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:27`

The AVDK interrupt map places SDIO at external IRQ 10:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h:30-41`

For NuttX this should be:

```text
BK7258_EXTIRQ_SDIO = 10
BK7258_IRQ_SDIO    = 16 + 10 = 26
```

The current OpenVela IRQ header does not define it:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/include/irq.h:24-41`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_irq.h:10-16`

Once defined, normal `up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SDIO)` will route external IRQ 10 to CPU1 and enable it in the NVIC:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_irq.c:27-51`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_irq.c:145-178`

## 2.2 FIFO data ports are 32-bit MMIO registers

The FIFO ports are:

| Register | Offset | Width | Meaning |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| TX FIFO input | `0x0f * 4 = 0x3c` | 32 bits | Software writes one word |
| RX FIFO output | `0x10 * 4 = 0x40` | 32 bits | Software reads one word |

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:143-147`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h:324-332`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:306-314`

These are word ports, but that does **not** permit dereferencing arbitrary user buffers as `uint32_t *`.

## 2.3 Per-word readiness flags

In `SD_FIFO_THRESHOLD`, offset `0x44`:

- Bit 18, `rx_fifo_rd_ready`: RX FIFO is not empty.
- Bit 19, `tx_fifo_wr_ready`: TX FIFO is not full.

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:149-170`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:296-304`

These are the safest conditions for moving individual words:

```c
while (remaining != 0 && RX_READY)
  read one 32-bit word;

while (remaining != 0 && TX_READY)
  write one 32-bit word;
```

## 2.4 FIFO thresholds and watermark conditions

Threshold fields are both 8 bits:

- RX threshold: bits 0–7.
- TX threshold: bits 8–15.

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:150-157`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h:334-352`

The generated descriptions say:

- RX need-read asserts when FIFO occupancy is more than the programmed threshold.
- TX need-write asserts when FIFO occupancy is less than the programmed threshold.

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:509-525`

The LL defines threshold value `1` as 16 bytes:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:28-29`

Thus the best local interpretation is that the threshold count is in **16-byte units**, not 32-bit words. This should still be verified on hardware.

### Exact FIFO depth is not established

The local BK7258 datasheet says SDIO supports 1-bit, 4-bit, and optional DMA, but does not specify an SDIO FIFO depth:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258 Datasheet.pdf`, §4.11, page 68.

The “embedded 16-byte TX/RX FIFO” immediately following the SDIO section belongs to the **I2C** section, not SDIO.

The DMA code comments that 512+16 bytes may remain in the SDIO FIFO/pipeline after DMA completion:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:931-940`

That is operational evidence of at least a block-sized staging path, but it is **not sufficient to declare a documented 528-byte FIFO depth**. A robust driver should use the readiness bits and validated thresholds rather than a guessed depth.

## 2.5 Interrupt status bits

At status register offset `0x34`, the host-relevant fields are:

| Bit | Condition |
|---:|---|
| 0 | Command without response completed |
| 1 | Command response completed |
| 2 | Command response timeout |
| 3 | Receive-data end |
| 4 | Write-data end |
| 5 | Data timeout |
| 6 | RX FIFO need read |
| 7 | TX FIFO need write |
| 8 | RX FIFO overflow |
| 9 | TX FIFO empty |
| 10 | Command-response CRC OK |
| 11 | Command-response CRC fail |
| 12 | Data CRC OK |
| 13 | Data CRC fail |
| 14–19 | Response command index |
| 20–22 | Write data-response status |
| 23 | Card/data busy |

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:91-117`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h:206-269`

Write status value `2` is documented by the LL as the successful card data response:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:399-403`

Most terminal status bits are W1C. Clearing should use a locally constructed mask, never read/modify/write the whole status register indiscriminately:

- Command clear mask:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:152-160`
- Read-data clear mask:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:354-362`
- Write-data clear mask:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:343-347`

There is a generated-header defect: `SDIO_HOST_F_DATA_CRC_OK` is `BIT(12)`, but its `_S` field is incorrectly declared as 13:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h:92-100`

Use the bit mask, not the erroneous shift constant.

# 3. Existing RX PIO behavior

## 3.1 Setup

For a read, the current AVDK v2 path:

1. Sets RX threshold to `1`.
2. Configures multi-block mode and block size.
3. Enables receive-end IRQ.
4. Does not enable RX need-read IRQ.
5. Starts the receive data engine.
6. Programs the hardware data timer.

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:824-854`

The SD card layer performs data setup before CMD18:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:1589-1618`

That ordering agrees with NuttX read semantics.

## 3.2 Completion IRQ

The ISR handles:

- Receive end
- Data timeout
- CRC OK/fail

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1390-1443`

On CRC OK it posts `rx_sema`. On CRC fail it:

- Resets FIFO/SD state.
- Sets a global CRC-error flag.
- Posts the semaphore.

On data timeout it logs and clears the timeout status, but does **not** post the semaphore:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1408-1429`

That means a hardware timeout is converted into an additional software semaphore timeout. This should not be copied.

RX overflow and RX need-read handling are commented out in the ISR condition:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1391-1394`

## 3.3 FIFO drain

After each block-completion semaphore, the calling thread drains exactly 512 bytes:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1199-1234`

Each word read polls `rx_fifo_rd_ready`, waits 1 µs per iteration, and fails after 400 µs:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1178-1196`

The word is unpacked in little-endian CPU order:

```c
p[0] = word;
p[1] = word >> 8;
p[2] = word >> 16;
p[3] = word >> 24;
```

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1208-1216`

This fixed-512-byte helper cannot be used directly for NuttX because NuttX also reads the 8-byte SCR:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:493-513`

A new lower-half must support arbitrary `nbytes`, at least 8 and 512, rather than wrapping `bk_sdio_host_read_blks_fifo()`.

# 4. Existing TX PIO behavior

## 4.1 Setup and FIFO filling

For writes, the current path configures:

- TX threshold `1`
- Multi-block mode
- 512-byte block size

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:848-853`

The CPU path then:

1. Polls `tx_fifo_wr_ready`.
2. Writes one 32-bit word.
3. Repeats until the first 512 bytes are in the FIFO.
4. Enables TX FIFO clock-gate behavior.
5. Starts the write state machine.
6. Waits for a semaphore at each 512-byte boundary.

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:946-1027`

The write state machine starts only at:

```c
if (index == 512)
```

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1001-1006`

Therefore a transfer shorter than 512 bytes would never start in this implementation. The public API explicitly requires 512-byte alignment of transfer size:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/sdio_host.h:156-170`

A native NuttX implementation must not inherit that implicit start condition.

## 4.2 Block completion

The PIO ISR waits for `DATA_WR_END`, checks card write-response status, then posts the TX semaphore:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1323-1388`

Important distinctions:

- `TX_FIFO_EMPTY` only means the host FIFO drained.
- `DATA_WR_END` is used as the indication that data reached the card and the card supplied its data-response token.
- The existing source explicitly says FIFO empty is not enough:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1008-1015`

The ISR polls `wr_status` up to 100 iterations, but merely logs an invalid status and still follows the normal completion path:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1348-1379`

The new lower-half must turn `wr_status != 2` into `SDIOWAIT_ERROR`, not successful completion.

## 4.3 Existing TX timeout is not elapsed-time based

The FIFO write loop declares failure whenever an incrementing CPU loop counter reaches a multiple of `0x400000`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:960-971`

This is CPU-frequency- and optimization-dependent, not a real timeout. It should be replaced with:

- Hardware data timer.
- NuttX watchdog timeout from `waitenable()`.
- Optionally a bounded ISR word count, but not a fake time derived from loop iterations.

# 5. Block boundaries and multi-block limitations

The hardware data-control register contains:

- One 12-bit block-size field.
- A single/multi-block selector.
- No visible host block-count register in this register map.

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:60-74`

The setup functions set:

- `sd_data_mul_blk`
- `sd_data_blk = block_size & 0xfff`

Sources:

- Write:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:228-240`
- Read:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:260-279`

Although `sdio_host_data_config_t` contains `data_len`, the v2 setup code does not use it:

- Definition:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/sdio_host_types.h:49-54`
- Configuration:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:824-854`

Thus total byte count and block count must remain software state in the NuttX lower-half.

For the first PIO implementation:

```text
CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1
```

is strongly recommended. NuttX documents that value 1 as a workaround for lower-halves that cannot safely handle multi-block transfer:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/Kconfig:57-65`

This avoids the AVDK “pre-read one extra block” behavior and delayed CMD12 optimization until single-block PIO is proven.

The current AVDK pre-read recovery sequence resets FIFO/SD state before enabling free-running clock and sending CMD12:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:649-708`

That behavior matters later for CMD18, but should not be in the first single-block lower-half.

# 6. Timeouts

## 6.1 Hardware timers

The command and data timers are full 32-bit registers:

- Command timer:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:54-59`
- Data timer:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:76-77`

The generated command-timer documentation explicitly leaves the unit uncertain:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:150-169`

The AVDK driver treats the values as SD clock counts and scales them approximately by selected clock. For example:

- 13 MHz command: 13,000, approximately 1 ms.
- 13 MHz data: 416,000, approximately 32 ms.
- 20 MHz command: 20,000.
- 20 MHz data: 640,000.

Sources:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:55-72`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:127-215`

Those values are useful starting points but require measurement because the generated hardware documentation is not authoritative about timer units.

## 6.2 Existing command wait flaw

The v2 command completion path uses a queue and waits only `SDIO_CMD_WAIT_TIME`, defined as 4 RTOS ticks:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:46-57`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:763-785`

The ISR only queues successful command-end events. CRC failure or hardware response timeout is generally not queued:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1275-1321`

As a result, CRC failure and hardware timeout often appear to the caller merely as queue timeout. The NuttX driver should instead retain the exact terminal condition and return:

- Response timeout: `-ETIMEDOUT`
- Response CRC/index failure: `-EIO`
- Successful response: `OK`

## 6.3 NuttX watchdog timing

NuttX uses:

- 100 ms per read block:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:83-97`
- Configurable write timeout, default 260 ms:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/Kconfig:173-178`

Recommended policy:

1. Program a hardware data timeout below or equal to the NuttX watchdog timeout.
2. Let the hardware IRQ report a precise timeout when possible.
3. Keep the NuttX watchdog as the final guarantee against a missing IRQ, stopped clock, or controller lockup.
4. Every hardware timeout ISR must terminate the transfer and post the wait semaphore immediately.

# 7. Alignment and endian handling

## 7.1 Existing TX has an alignment and over-read defect

The current non-BK7256 TX path does:

```c
*(uint32_t *)&write_data[index]
```

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:975-989`

Problems:

- Undefined or faulting unaligned 32-bit load.
- Reads beyond the buffer for a non-multiple-of-four length.
- Assumes CPU and FIFO byte order without making it explicit.

The first OpenVela driver should retain `uint8_t *` buffer pointers and assemble words explicitly:

```c
word = p[0] |
       ((uint32_t)p[1] << 8) |
       ((uint32_t)p[2] << 16) |
       ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24);
```

For a partial final word, initialize the word to zero and insert only the valid bytes. On RX, read one word and copy only `min(remaining, 4)` bytes.

That supports:

- Unaligned buffers.
- 8-byte SCR transfers.
- Non-four-byte SDIO-function transfers if later required.
- Predictable behavior independent of compiler alignment assumptions.

## 7.2 Byte-selection controls are not fully trustworthy from comments alone

The data-control register has separate RX and TX byte-selection bits:

- `sd_byte_sel`, bit 17
- `sd_tx_byte_sel`, bit 18

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:60-74`

The generated description says bit 17 rearranges received bytes and bit 18 rearranges transmitted bytes:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:289-323`

The AVDK setup sets `sd_byte_sel = 1`, including write configuration, but does not explicitly set `sd_tx_byte_sel`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:214-278`

The TX code comments that BK7258 V5 and later perform TX byte reversal in hardware without software reversal:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:975-987`

Recommended approach:

- Use explicit byte packing/unpacking.
- Start with the same RX `sd_byte_sel=1` behavior as the proven AVDK path.
- Do not add software byte swapping to TX merely because SD protocol fields are conventionally displayed MSB-first.
- Validate with patterns such as `00 01 02 03`, MBR signature `55 aa`, FAT strings, and sector hashes.
- Treat response-register word order separately from FIFO byte order, especially for R2/CID/CSD.

# 8. FIFO reset and recovery

## 8.1 Reset polarity is contradictory in the local headers

The structure comments call FIFO and SD-state resets “high active”:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:154-158`

The generated LL comments say they are low-active and reset by writing zero:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:1046-1080`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:1100-1116`

The host reset helper writes zero:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:31-36`

But the data-setup functions assign one to the same reset fields:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:214-245`

This must be settled by:

1. Golden-firmware register tracing, or
2. Controlled hardware test that fills/drains the FIFO, applies each sequence, and checks readiness and stale status.

Do not reproduce both forms throughout a new driver. Define one tested helper such as:

```c
bk7258_sdio_reset_data_path(direction);
```

and keep the polarity workaround in that one place.

## 8.2 Required recovery sequence

On cancel, CRC failure, FIFO overflow, impossible end condition, or watchdog timeout:

1. Mask RX/TX FIFO and data-terminal interrupts.
2. Stop or gate the data engine.
3. Save status and remaining count for diagnostics.
4. Clear known W1C data bits using a constructed mask.
5. Reset the active-direction FIFO and SD command/data state using the verified reset sequence.
6. Clear software transfer state and stale semaphore count.
7. End any armed wait with `SDIOWAIT_ERROR` or `SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT`.
8. If a multi-block command was active, recover card protocol state with CMD12 after the host state is safe.
9. If the next command still fails, reset/reinitialize the controller.
10. Power-cycle the soldered SD NAND only as the last board-level recovery.

The existing ISR resets state on CRC failure because pre-read can leave invalid data:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1408-1424`

It also documents a potential permanent IRQ loop if stale read status is left after a FIFO reset:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1430-1442`

That is a critical recovery requirement: after reset, clear every relevant W1C condition and verify the status no longer retriggers.

# 9. NuttX `recvsetup`, `sendsetup`, and `eventwait` semantics

## 9.1 `recvsetup()`

NuttX defines `recvsetup()` as preparation for a non-DMA, interrupt-driven card-to-memory transfer:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/sdio.h:603-625`

For normal block reads, the upper-half order is:

```text
blocksetup
waitenable
recvsetup
CMD17/CMD18
eventwait
```

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1571-1616`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1723-1779`

For the 8-byte SCR, the order is slightly different:

```text
blocksetup
recvsetup
waitenable
CMD55
ACMD51
eventwait
```

Source:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:493-545`

Therefore `waitenable()` must not destroy a transfer already prepared by `recvsetup()`. It may clear stale interrupt status and stale wait events, but it must not reset the newly configured RX FIFO/data path.

`recvsetup()` should:

- Validate and save the byte buffer and total length.
- Configure direction, block length, and single/multi mode.
- Reset only the relevant stale data path.
- Enable RX watermark, receive-end, timeout, CRC, and overflow handling.
- Arrange for the receive state machine to be ready before the command starts.
- Return `OK`; if a setup error is latched, ensure `eventwait()` will return `SDIOWAIT_ERROR`.

## 9.2 `sendsetup()`

NuttX sends CMD24 before normal PIO setup because the lower-half should not advertise `SDIO_CAPS_DMABEFOREWRITE`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1897-1956`

Order:

```text
CMD24 and R1
blocksetup
waitenable
sendsetup
eventwait
```

`sendsetup()` should:

- Save source buffer and length.
- Configure TX path and block size.
- Clear stale write-end/timeout/FIFO status.
- Prime as much FIFO data as possible using `tx_fifo_wr_ready`.
- Enable TX need-write and terminal/error IRQs.
- Start the TX state machine only after enough data has been primed.

For the initial single-block implementation, following the proven AVDK behavior and priming the entire 512-byte block before asserting write start is conservative. For shorter transfers, start after all requested bytes have been primed rather than waiting for exactly 512 bytes.

## 9.3 Return-value discrepancy

The header text says setup returns the number of bytes on success:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/sdio.h:615-622`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/sdio.h:636-643`

In practice, existing lower-halves return `OK`, for example:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lpc17xx_40xx/lpc17_40_sdcard.c:1730-1766`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lpc17xx_40xx/lpc17_40_sdcard.c:1789-1822`

The MMCSD upper half also does not check the PIO setup return in its normal paths:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1590-1593`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1932-1936`

The required semantics are:

- Discard stale wait state and pending status.
- Install the new `waitevents`.
- Arm hardware IRQ masks.

- A timeout of zero means an immediate timeout.

1. Save `wkupevent`.
2. Disable the corresponding wait IRQs.

4. Post `waitsem`.

# 10. Recommended interrupt-assisted PIO state machine

## RX ISR

For each IRQ:

1. Read status once, intersect it with enabled host masks, and retain the raw snapshot.
2. Check timeout, CRC failure, and overflow.
3. If RX need-read or receive-end is present, drain while:
   - `remaining > 0`, and
   - `rx_fifo_rd_ready != 0`.
4. On receive-end, perform a final drain because the remaining tail may be below the watermark.
5. Complete successfully only if:
   - Data CRC is OK, and
   - `remaining == 0`.
6. If receive-end arrives with bytes still missing and FIFO no longer ready, report `SDIOWAIT_ERROR`.
7. Clear all processed W1C bits.
8. On terminal state, mask transfer IRQs and publish the event.

Do not post `TRANSFERDONE` merely because one hardware block-end IRQ occurred if software still has bytes remaining.

## TX ISR

1. On TX need-write, refill while `remaining > 0 && tx_fifo_wr_ready`.
2. Do not treat FIFO empty as transfer completion.
3. On write-end:
   - Ensure all requested bytes were supplied.
   - Check `wr_status == 2`.
   - Otherwise publish `SDIOWAIT_ERROR`.
4. On data timeout, CRC/data-response error, or unexpected FIFO starvation, publish the corresponding failure immediately.
5. Disable TX watermark IRQ once `remaining == 0`, but keep write-end/error IRQs enabled until card acceptance is known.

## ISR constraints

The current AVDK ISR uses one `if/else-if` chain:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1275-1446`

A new ISR should preferably loop over pending enabled conditions until no serviceable status remains, with a strict iteration bound. This handles simultaneous FIFO and terminal status safely.

Do not:

- Allocate memory.
- Print per FIFO event.
- Wait for card busy in the ISR.
- Perform FAT/MMCSD operations.
- Execute mailbox clock requests from the ISR.

4-bit wire mode increases byte rate at a given clock and therefore increases FIFO service pressure. It is independent of DMA functionally, but it should be enabled only after:

# 13. Eight-pin SD NAND interpretation

The statement is:

```text
SDD2 CD/SDD3 SCLK VSS CMD SDD0 SDD1 VCC
```

There are two materially different interpretations.

## Interpretation A: literal package pin order from pin 1 through pin 8

If each token is one consecutive package pin, the mapping is:

| Package pin | Signal | BK7258 connection |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | DAT2 / SDD2 | GPIO18 |
| 2 | CD/DAT3 / SDD3 | GPIO19 |
| 3 | SCLK | GPIO14 |
| 4 | VSS | Ground |
| 5 | CMD | GPIO15 |
| 6 | DAT0 / SDD0 | GPIO16 |
| 7 | DAT1 / SDD1 | GPIO17 |
| 8 | VCC | SD NAND supply |

Under this interpretation, **pin 3 is CLK**, not CMD.

This is a plausible proprietary/soldered SD NAND LGA/QFN package arrangement. A soldered SD NAND package is not required to preserve the physical contact order of a removable microSD card.

## Interpretation B: standard microSD contact numbering

Standard microSD contact order is:

| microSD pin | Signal | BK7258 connection |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | DAT2 | GPIO18 |
| 2 | CD/DAT3 | GPIO19 |
| 3 | CMD | GPIO15 |
| 4 | VDD | Supply |
| 5 | CLK | GPIO14 |
| 6 | VSS | Ground |
| 7 | DAT0 | GPIO16 |
| 8 | DAT1 | GPIO17 |

Under this convention, **pin 3 is CMD** and pin 5 is CLK.

## Explicit interpretation warning

The user-provided sequence does **not** match standard microSD contact order after pin 2:

```text
Given:     DAT2 DAT3 CLK VSS CMD DAT0 DAT1 VCC
microSD:   DAT2 DAT3 CMD VDD CLK VSS DAT0 DAT1
```

Therefore:

- If the quoted string is copied from the package datasheet’s “pin 1…pin 8” table, use Interpretation A.
- If it is an informal list of SD signals rather than physical pin numbering, it cannot establish pin 3.
- Do not assume a soldered SD NAND’s eight-package-pin order equals microSD contact order.
- Confirm the exact device marking, manufacturer datasheet, package top-view/bottom-view convention, and pin-1 dot.
- Verify VCC and VSS before applying power. Confusing the two interpretations can put supply voltage on CMD/CLK or ground the wrong pin.

`CD/DAT3` here is the SD protocol DAT3/card-detect function, not necessarily a separate mechanical card-detect switch. For a fixed soldered device it should be used as DAT3 in 4-bit mode.

# 14. Robust PIO-first implementation recommendations

## Required first-stage configuration

```text
CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO=y
CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_SDIO=y
CONFIG_MMCSD=y
CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIO=y
CONFIG_SDIO_BLOCKSETUP=y
CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1

# CONFIG_DMA is not set
# CONFIG_SDIO_DMA is not set
# CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO_DMA is not set
# CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIOWAIT_WRCOMPLETE is not set
```

The generic NuttX DMA vtable is conditionally present only under `CONFIG_SDIO_DMA`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/sdio.h:1028-1042`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/Kconfig:122-124`

Do not add DMA stubs and do not alias DMA setup methods to PIO methods. Simply leave DMA disabled.

## Bring-up sequence

1. Add the SDIO base/register header.
2. Add external IRQ 10/NuttX IRQ 26.
3. Add GPIO14–19 board definitions and verified SD NAND power rail.
4. Implement clock request and verify register access.
5. Implement command-only probe in one-bit mode.
6. Implement 8-byte PIO read for SCR.
7. Implement 512-byte CMD17 reads.
8. Register `/dev/mmcsd0`.
9. Compare sector hashes against golden firmware.
10. Implement CMD24 write only after read stability.
11. Stress single-block PIO.
12. Enable 4-bit PIO at conservative clock.
13. Only later consider multi-block; DMA remains out of scope.

## Driver invariants

- One transfer owner at a time.
- `remaining` is the authoritative software transfer count.
- Never read/write a FIFO word unless its ready flag permits it.
- Never signal success until the buffer count reaches zero and the terminal hardware status is valid.
- Never treat TX FIFO empty as card write completion.
- Every error path masks IRQs, clears W1C status, resets the data path, and wakes a waiter.
- `eventwait()` always returns a nonzero event.
- `cancel()` leaves the controller able to issue the next command without a system reboot.
- No unaligned `uint32_t *` dereferences.
- No guessed FIFO depth.
- No DMA capability bit.
- No ISR logging on each watermark event.

## Recommended initial mode

For maximum robustness:

- One-bit mode.
- 100 kHz identification clock.
- 6.5 or 13 MHz transfer clock.
- Single-block CMD17/CMD24.
- RX/TX watermark IRQs enabled.
- Hardware timer plus NuttX watchdog.
- Fixed storage reported present.
- No write-protect.
- No write-complete D0 GPIO mode.
- No FAT mount until raw block reads match golden data.

Once this path is stable, 4-bit PIO can be enabled independently, but only after DAT1–DAT3 wiring and package interpretation are physically confirmed.

+# BK7258 OpenVela AP SDIO 与 1 GB SD-NAND 移植设计方案 V2
+
+> 文档状态：结合 8-pin SD-NAND 封装信息、`bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` CP/AP 最终配置和 ELF、BK7258 SDIO V2 PIO 路径、NuttX MMCSD 接口及 BK7236N vendor 目录重新核对后的设计基线。本文是实施方案，不表示驱动已实现或通过实板验收。
+
+## 1. 输入条件和固定结论
+
+### 1.1 已知硬件条件
+
+当前板载介质：
+
+- 容量：1 GB。
+- 封装：8 pin，焊接固定介质，不可热插拔。
+- 接口：标准 SD Memory 信号，器件内部完成 NAND FTL、ECC、坏块管理和磨损均衡。
+- 信号已上拉，OpenVela 不依赖内部 pull-up。
+- 封装 pin 1 至 pin 8 的顺序由用户确认为：
+
+```text
+pin 1  SDD2 / DAT2
+pin 2  CD/SDD3 / DAT3
+pin 3  SCLK
+pin 4  VSS
+pin 5  CMD
+pin 6  SDD0 / DAT0
+pin 7  SDD1 / DAT1
+pin 8  VCC
+```
+
+这里按器件封装 pin table 解释，不套用 microSD 卡座触点编号。标准 microSD 的 pin 3 是 CMD、pin 5 是 CLK，与本器件提供的封装顺序不同；PCB、器件 top/bottom view 和 pin-1 标记仍应在首次上电前复核，避免把卡座编号误用于焊接封装。
+
+`CD/SDD3` 是 SD 协议中的 DAT3/上电 card-detect 复用信号，不是独立机械插卡检测脚。该器件固定焊接，因此 NuttX 不启用 card-detect GPIO。
+
+### 1.2 器件引脚到 BK7258 的连接
+
+`bk_solution_ai` 板型使用 BK7258 GPIO14 至 GPIO19：
+
+| SD-NAND pin | SD 信号 | BK7258 GPIO | BK GPIO function | 首版 |
+| ---: | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
+| 1 | DAT2 | GPIO18 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA2` | 保持 SDIO/上拉，1-bit 不传数据 |
+| 2 | DAT3 | GPIO19 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA3` | 保持 SDIO/上拉，1-bit 不传数据 |
+| 3 | CLK | GPIO14 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_CLK` | 使用 |
+| 4 | VSS | GND | - | 使用 |
+| 5 | CMD | GPIO15 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_CMD` | 使用 |
+| 6 | DAT0 | GPIO16 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA0` | 使用 |
+| 7 | DAT1 | GPIO17 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA1` | 保持 SDIO/上拉，1-bit 不传数据 |
+| 8 | VCC | 3.3 V rail，待原理图确认控制方式 | - | 使用 |
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_solution_ai/projects/beken_genie/ap/config/bk7258_ap/usr_gpio_cfg.h:36-41`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:42-47`
+
+首版虽然只使用 DAT0 传输，仍不得把 DAT1、DAT2、DAT3 复用给 PWM、LCD 或其他外设。SD 协议上电和切换 4-bit 时需要这些线保持合法电平；当前硬件已外部上拉，软件将其配置为 SDIO function/input，不额外开启内部 pull-up，避免改变电气参数。
+
+### 1.3 软件约束
+
+- 当前 OpenVela AP 已完成单核启动、日志、GPIO 和 PWM。
+- 当前 OpenVela AP 没有 DMA 外设适配。
+- 本方案固定为 PIO-only，不新增、包装或启用 Armino GDMA。
+- `CONFIG_DMA`、`CONFIG_SDIO_DMA` 和 BK7258 SDIO DMA capability 保持关闭。
+- 4-bit 与 DMA 在硬件上相互独立，但本方案只在 1-bit PIO稳定后评估 4-bit PIO。
+- CPU1/OpenVela AP 是 SDIO Host 和 SD-NAND 数据路径唯一所有者。
+- CPU0/CP 继续运行原厂固件，只提供既有 PWC/PM 中央时钟门控服务。
+- CPU2 不访问 SDIO。
+
+### 1.4 固定软件架构
+
+```text
+OpenVela application / NSH
+          |
+          v
+NuttX FAT filesystem，vfat
+          |
+          v
+/dev/mmcsd0 或 /dev/mmcsd0p0
+          |
+          v
+NuttX drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c
+          |
+          | struct sdio_dev_s
+          v
+BK7258 SDIO lower-half，CPU1/AP，IRQ-assisted PIO
+          |
+          | GPIO14 CLK, GPIO15 CMD, GPIO16..19 DAT0..3
+          v
+板载 1 GB 8-pin SD-NAND
+
+CPU0/原厂 CP
+          |
+          `-- PWC/PM clock gate only，不读写 sector
+```
+
+### 1.5 首版参数
+
+| 项目 | 首版设置 |
+| --- | --- |
+| 介质 | 固定 present，无 hotplug/write-protect |
+| 协议 | SD Memory，关闭 MMC/eMMC support |
+| 总线 | 1-bit，CLK/CMD/DAT0 |
+| ID clock | BK 编码 7，约 101.5625 kHz |
+| transfer clock | 先 6.5 或 13 MHz，稳定后验证 20 MHz |
+| 数据路径 | RX/TX FIFO 水位 IRQ 驱动 PIO |
+| sector | 512 bytes |
+| multi-block | 首版限制为 1 block/request |
+| DMA | 明确关闭，不在本方案范围 |
+| 文件系统 | 先只读识别现有 FAT32 |
+| 设备节点 | `/dev/mmcsd0` |
+| 自动格式化 | 禁止 |
+
+AVDK 已在 1-bit PIO 下使用 20 MHz，但 NuttX lower-half 的 IRQ水位搬运模型与 AVDK 线程轮询模型不同。为避免首版 ISR latency 造成 FIFO overflow/underflow，先以 6.5 或 13 MHz验证，之后再升到 20 MHz。
+
+### 1.6 不采用的方案
+
+- 不使用 MTD、raw NAND、page/OOB、软件 ECC 或软件 FTL。
+- 不把 Armino `sd_card_driver.c` 直接注册为 NuttX 块设备。
+- 不链接 BK7236N 或 BK7258 Armino `libdriver.a` 的 SDIO实现。
+- 不修改原厂 CP 固件来代理 sector/file IO。
+- 不让 CP、AP、USB MSC 同时访问同一介质。
+- 不启用 DMA，不增加 DMA stub，不上报 `SDIO_CAPS_DMASUPPORTED`。
+- 不照搬 AVDK 在线程中轮询 512-byte FIFO 的 RTOS semaphore模型。
+- 不首轮启用 multiblock、4-bit、自动断电、热插拔或自动格式化。
+
+## 2. 原厂 AP/CP 所有权结论
+
+### 2.1 `app_ab` CPU0/CP 最终固件不访问 SD-NAND
+
+当前最终 CP 配置：
+
+```text
+bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config
+bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h
+```
+
+其中不存在以下启用项：
+
+```text
+CONFIG_SDIO_HOST
+CONFIG_SDCARD
+CONFIG_FATFS
+CONFIG_FATFS_SDCARD
+CONFIG_VFS
+CONFIG_USBD_MSC
+```
+
+生成的 CP `sdkconfig.h` 到文件末尾也没有这些宏：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h:250-295`
+
+CP driver init 对 SDIO 的调用受条件编译保护：
+
+```c
+#if ((CONFIG_SDIO_HOST) || (CONFIG_SDCARD))
+  bk_sdio_host_driver_init();
+#endif
+```
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:179-185`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:512-514`
+
+当前 CP ELF 符号核对结果：
+
+- 有通用向量符号 `SDIO_Handler`，因为 SoC vector table覆盖所有外部中断。
+- 没有 `bk_sdio_host_driver_init`、`bk_sdio_host_*`、`bk_sd_card_init`、`bk_sd_card_read_blocks` 或 `bk_sd_card_write_blocks` 实现符号。
+- CP map 没有链接 `sdio_host_driver.c.obj`、`sd_card_driver.c.obj`、`disk_io.c.obj` 或 `fatfs_adapter.c.obj`。
+
+因此，“CP 源码树存在 SDIO/SD card代码”不能解释为“当前原厂 CP 固件访问 SD-NAND”。这些是 dormant source，只有显式打开 CP 的 `CONFIG_SDIO_HOST`/`CONFIG_SDCARD` 后才可能参与构建。
+
+### 2.2 原厂 AP 是唯一数据面所有者
+
+原厂 AP 最终配置明确启用：
+
+```text
+CONFIG_VFS=y
+CONFIG_FATFS=y
+CONFIG_FATFS_SDCARD=y
+CONFIG_SDIO_HOST=y
+CONFIG_SDCARD=y
+CONFIG_SDIO_V2P0=y
+```
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:121-122`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:165-166`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:243-250`
+
+原厂 AP map/ELF 明确包含：
+
+- `sdio_host_driver.c.obj` 和 `sdio_host_isr`。
+- `sd_card_driver.c.obj`。
+- `disk_io.c.obj`、FatFS 和 `fatfs_adapter.c.obj`。
+- `bk_sdio_host_driver_init` 和 SDIO Handler。
+
+构建选择：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/CMakeLists.txt:329-335`
+
+结论：原厂架构是 AP 直接读写 SD-NAND。OpenVela 替换原厂 AP 后，应继续由 CPU1/AP 直接拥有 Host，不引入 CP proxy。
+
+### 2.3 CP仍参与中央时钟管理
+
+AP 对 `CLK_PWR_ID_SDIO` 的开关请求通过 PM Mailbox交给 CP；CP执行中央 clock gate寄存器写。这是“控制面服务”，不是“存储数据访问”。
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_clock_driver.c:22-40`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_pm/pm.c:1389-1400`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c:228-259`
+
+OpenVela 必须复用既有 PWC wire ABI 请求 SDIO clock。不能因为 CP 不读写 SD-NAND，就绕过 CP 直接改中央门控。
+
+### 2.4 CP dormant code 的防回归要求
+
+后续每次替换 CP 固件或修改其 config，都必须检查：
+
+```text
+CONFIG_SDIO_HOST is not set
+CONFIG_SDCARD is not set
+CONFIG_FATFS_SDCARD is not set
+CONFIG_USBD_MSC is not set
+```
+
+并检查 CP ELF：
+
+```bash
+arm-none-eabi-nm app.elf | grep -E \
+  'bk_sdio_host_|bk_sd_card_|sdio_host_isr|fatfs_adapter'
+```
+
+允许只出现通用 `SDIO_Handler` vector；若出现 Host/card实现符号，必须停止烧录并重新核定所有权。
+
+原厂 SD card driver在 `CONFIG_USBD_MSC && CONFIG_USB_DEVICE` 下有本地 owner vote：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:1839-1870`
+
+当前 CP 配置未启用该路径，而且该 owner变量只在单个固件地址空间内生效，不是 AP/CP 跨核锁。它不能防止两个核同时访问硬件，也不能作为 OpenVela 所有权协议。

+- `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/bk_idk/armino_as_lib/include/soc/bk7236n/reg_base.h:90`

+- `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/Make.defs:45-108` 无 SDIO source。

+### 3.2 可参考和不可复用边界
+
+可参考：
+
+- IRQ10 的编号一致性。
+- custom chip CMake/Make 条件加入 source 的组织方式。
+- strong ISR registration ABI覆盖预编译弱符号的思路。
+- Armino headers用于对照 API语义和 clock编码名称。

+不可复用：
+
+- BK7236N 的预编译 `libdriver.a`。
+- BK7236N startup、GPIO、clock、power或寄存器实现。

+- 把 `bk_sd_card_*` 当作 NuttX `sdio_dev_s`。

+因此 V2 方案以 `bk_avdk_smp` BK7258源码为硬件主参考，以 NuttX现有 ARM SDIO lower-half为接口主参考，BK7236N 仅为佐证。

+## 4. BK7258 Host 硬件基线
+
+### 4.1 寄存器和安全地址
+
+```text
+SDIO secure base = 0x458d0000
+TX FIFO          = base + 0x3c
+RX FIFO          = base + 0x40
+FIFO threshold   = base + 0x44
+```
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:123-126`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h:324-352`
+
+当前 OpenVela AP 按 Secure模式运行，固定使用 secure alias。寄存器生成头存在旧 base注释、CRC shift 和 reset polarity矛盾；实现必须把已实测行为封装在少量 helper 中，不散布 magic写法。
+
+### 4.2 中断
+
+```text
+INT_SRC_SDIO       = 10
+CPU1 route bit     = 10
+NuttX external IRQ = 10
+NuttX IRQ number   = 16 + 10 = 26
+```
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/int_types.h:98`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h:40`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sys_struct.h:523`
+
+目标使用 `irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SDIO, ...)`、`up_enable_irq()` 和现有 CPU1 route实现，不引入 Armino interrupt registration。
+
+### 4.3 FIFO和状态位
+
+FIFO MMIO端口为 32 bit。`SD_FIFO_THRESHOLD` 关键字段：
+
+| bit | 含义 |
+| ---: | --- |
+| 0..7 | RX threshold |
+| 8..15 | TX threshold |
+| 18 | RX FIFO read ready，FIFO非空 |
+| 19 | TX FIFO write ready，FIFO未满 |
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:143-170`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:296-314`
+
+Host interrupt status：
+
+| bit | 条件 |
+| ---: | --- |
+| 0 | command no-response complete |
+| 1 | command response complete |
+| 2 | command response timeout |
+| 3 | receive data end |
+| 4 | write data end |
+| 5 | data timeout |
+| 6 | RX FIFO need read |
+| 7 | TX FIFO need write |
+| 8 | RX FIFO overflow |
+| 9 | TX FIFO empty |
+| 10 | command response CRC OK |
+| 11 | command response CRC fail |
+| 12 | data CRC OK |
+| 13 | data CRC fail |
+| 14..19 | response command index |
+| 20..22 | card write response status，2表示 accepted |
+| 23 | data busy |
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:91-141`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:399-403`
+
+terminal status 多为 W1C。driver只能用明确构造的 mask清除已处理位，不能对整个 status寄存器做读改写。`DATA_CRC_OK` 应使用 `BIT(12)`，不使用 generated header中错误的 shift 13。
+
+### 4.4 AVDK PIO模型及其边界
+
+AVDK 当前 `CONFIG_SDIO_GDMA_EN=n`，但它的“PIO”不是完整的 FIFO watermark IRQ模式：
+
+- command和每块 data end通过 IRQ/RTOS semaphore通知。
+- calling thread轮询 `rx_fifo_rd_ready`/`tx_fifo_wr_ready` 并搬运32-bit word。
+- 默认 interrupt mask `0xe03f` 没有打开 bit6 RX need-read和bit7 TX need-write。
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:445-449`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:946-1027`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1178-1245`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1275-1443`
+
+该模型适合 Armino同步 API，但不直接符合 NuttX `recvsetup()/sendsetup()` 后由 `eventwait()`等待异步完成的接口。OpenVela lower-half 应改为 IRQ-assisted PIO：ISR在 FIFO watermark时搬运数据，task只等待完成事件。
+
+### 4.5 时钟
+
+AVDK clock enum是寄存器编码：
+
+| 模式 | 编码 | 参考频率 |
+| --- | ---: | ---: |
+| ID | 7 | 26 MHz / 256，约101.5625 kHz |
+| conservative transfer | 12或13，须按专用编码表核对 | 6.5或13 MHz |
+| reference transfer | 14 | 320 MHz / 16，20 MHz |
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/hal/hal_sdio_host_types.h:25-43`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdcard/sdio_driver.h:202-215`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:983-987`
+
+编码写入前必须再次按 enum和实测波形核对，不根据通用 SYS divider注释猜值。首版 ID clock和transfer clock均用示波器/逻辑分析仪确认。
+
+### 4.6 PWC时钟前置条件
+
+OpenVela 当前 PWC transport尚未完整消费 transport ACK和PM语义响应。SDIO开钟不能沿用 PWM的固定延时规避方式。
+
+必须先提供：
+
+```text
+bk7258_pwc_clock_request(CLK_PWR_ID_SDIO, ON, timeout)
+  -> 发原厂兼容 PWC command
+  -> 等待 ACK/completion，或轮询可靠 gate/readback
+  -> 成功后才访问 0x458d0000
+```
+
+若 CP ABI没有单独语义响应，则以有限超时的 central gate readback或 SDIO可访问性验证闭环。任何失败停止 MMCSD bind，返回错误，不用 blind delay。
+
+## 5. NuttX lower-half 设计
+
+### 5.1 绑定方式
+
+```c
+struct sdio_dev_s *dev = bk7258_sdio_initialize(0);
+ret = mmcsd_slotinitialize(0, dev);
+```
+
+成功后注册 `/dev/mmcsd0`。
+
+依据：
+
+- `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/sdio.h:925-1045`
+- `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/mmcsd.h:151-165`
+- `openvela/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:4548-4648`
+
+NuttX `mmcsd_sdio.c` 负责 CMD0、CMD8、ACMD41、CID、CSD、RCA、SCR、选卡、ACMD6、sector addressing和块设备。BK lower-half不重复卡协议状态机。
+
+### 5.2 PIO-only operation table
+
+必须实现：
+
+| operation | 职责 |
+| --- | --- |
+| `reset` | mask IRQ、停 data path、清W1C、复位 FIFO/command/data和软件状态 |
+| `capabilities` | 首版 `SDIO_CAPS_1BIT_ONLY`；不返回任何 DMA flag |
+| `status` | 固定 `SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT` |
+| `widebus` | 无transfer时切 Host 1/4-bit |
+| `clock` | disabled、ID、1-bit transfer、4-bit transfer |
+| `attach` | attach IRQ26，清pending，启用 CPU1 route/NVIC |
+| `sendcmd` | 解析 decorated cmd并配置 index/arg/response/CRC/data方向 |
+| `blocksetup` | 保存 block size、block count和总字节数 |
+| `recvsetup` | 保存 byte buffer/remaining，配置 RX PIO和 IRQ |
+| `sendsetup` | 保存 byte buffer/remaining，prime TX FIFO并配置 IRQ |
+| `cancel` | 终止transfer、清状态并唤醒waiter |
+| `waitresponse` | 有界等待 command terminal status |
+| response readers | R1/R1b/R2/R3/R6/R7；R4/R5非空stub返回 `-ENOSYS` |
+| `waitenable` | 设置 event mask和watchdog，不破坏已配置transfer |
+| `eventwait` | race-safe等待并返回非零event |
+| media callbacks | 固定介质保存callback，正常不触发 |
+
+不编译 `dmarecvsetup`、`dmasendsetup` 或 `dmapreflight`，不提供伪DMA实现。
+
+### 5.3 私有状态
+
+建议：
+
+```c
+struct bk7258_sdio_s
+{
+  struct sdio_dev_s dev;
+  sem_t waitsem;
+  struct wdog_s waitwdog;
+  spinlock_t lock;
+  volatile sdio_eventset_t waitevents;
+  volatile sdio_eventset_t wakeevent;
+  uint8_t *buffer;
+  size_t remaining;
+  size_t blocklen;
+  size_t nblocks;
+  bool receive;
+  bool transfer_active;
+  bool command_active;
+  uint32_t last_status;
+  uint32_t last_cmd;
+  int last_error;
+  sdio_event_callback_t callback;
+  void *cbarg;
+};
+```
+
+实际实现不必机械照抄字段，但必须有唯一transfer owner、authoritative `remaining`、wait race保护和诊断快照。
+
+### 5.4 command path
+
+`sendcmd()` 接收的是 decorated command：
+
+```text
+MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK
+MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK
+MMCSD_DATAXFR_MASK
+MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK
+MMCSD_STOPXFR
+MMCSD_OPENDRAIN
+```
+
+lower-half解析后配置 hardware。响应策略：
+
+- no response/CMD0：等待 command-no-response complete。
+- R1/R1b/R6/R7：校验 timeout、CRC和response command index。
+- R2/CID/CSD：读取4 words，按 NuttX预期顺序返回。
+- R3/OCR：不要求CRC。
+- hardware response timeout返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`。
+- CRC/index error返回 `-EIO`，不能退化成软件queue timeout。
+
+### 5.5 RX IRQ-assisted PIO
+
+`recvsetup()` 必须支持至少：
+
+- 8-byte SCR。
+- 512-byte sector。
+- 后续多块的 `n * 512`。
+
+流程：
+
+1. 验证无 active transfer，保存 byte buffer和总长度。
+2. 配置 block size、single/multi、RX direction和hardware data timer。
+3. 清 stale RX end/timeout/CRC/overflow/need-read status。
+4. 配置经实测的 RX threshold。
+5. enable RX need-read、RX end、data timeout、CRC fail和overflow IRQ。
+6. card command启动后，ISR在 RX watermark或RX end时搬运。
+
+ISR算法：
+
+```text
+read enabled pending status
+if timeout/CRC fail/overflow:
+    recover + wake ERROR/TIMEOUT
+if RX_NEED_READ or RX_END:
+    while remaining > 0 and RX_READY:
+        word = RX_FIFO
+        copy min(remaining, 4) bytes
+if RX_END:
+    final drain while RX_READY
+    success only when remaining == 0 and data CRC OK
+clear processed W1C bits
+```
+
+不能在每个硬件block-end后假定整个请求完成；software `remaining`归零且terminal status合法才完成。
+
+### 5.6 TX IRQ-assisted PIO
+
+NuttX普通 PIO write顺序是 CMD24/R1 后 `blocksetup -> waitenable -> sendsetup -> eventwait`。首版单块写：
+
+1. 保存 source byte buffer和512-byte length。
+2. 清 stale TX end/timeout/CRC/FIFO status。
+3. 配置 TX threshold、data timer和single block。
+4. 使用 `TX_READY` 先尽可能 prime FIFO。
+5. 启动 write state machine。
+6. enable TX need-write、write end、timeout和error IRQ。
+7. ISR在 TX need-write时继续填 FIFO。
+8. `remaining == 0` 后关闭TX watermark IRQ，但保留 write-end/error IRQ。
+9. 只有 `DATA_WR_END` 且 card write-response status为2才成功。
+
+`TX_FIFO_EMPTY` 只表示 Host FIFO空，不表示 card已经接受或完成program，不能作为 transfer done。
+
+### 5.7 alignment和byte order
+
+禁止：
+
+```c
+*(uint32_t *)buffer
+```
+
+AVDK当前TX路径存在任意用户buffer未对齐访问风险。OpenVela保留 `uint8_t *`，显式 little-endian组装/拆分：
+
+```c
+word = p[0] |
+       ((uint32_t)p[1] << 8) |
+       ((uint32_t)p[2] << 16) |
+       ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24);
+```
+
+末尾不足4 bytes时 word先清零，只复制有效字节。RX也只写 `min(remaining, 4)`。这样支持任意alignment、8-byte SCR和未来非4倍数transfer。
+
+FIFO byte-select寄存器沿用经验证的 AVDK RX设置，但以 sector pattern和FAT signature `55 aa`验证，不因协议字段显示顺序额外猜测 software byteswap。R2 response word order与data FIFO byte order分别测试。
+
+### 5.8 wait/event竞态
+
+NuttX可能出现：
+
+```text
+waitenable
+recvsetup/sendsetup
+sendcmd或start transfer
+IRQ在此完成
+eventwait
+```
+
+也有 SCR path先 `recvsetup` 再 `waitenable`。因此：
+
+- `recvsetup`配置好的RX path不能被随后的 `waitenable` reset。
+- `waitenable`清 stale wait event和terminal status，但不破坏当前transfer config。
+- ISR先保存 `wakeevent`，disable相关IRQ，cancel watchdog，再post semaphore。
+- `eventwait`必须能消费已经post的event，不得再次睡眠。
+- `eventwait`每条路径都cancel watchdog、关闭wait mask并返回非零event。
+
+参考结构：
+
+- `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lpc17xx_40xx/lpc17_40_sdcard.c:1066-1080`
+- `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lpc17xx_40xx/lpc17_40_sdcard.c:2195-2347`
+
+### 5.9 timeout
+
+两级超时：
+
+1. BK hardware command/data timer，提供精确terminal IRQ。
+2. NuttX watchdog，防止IRQ丢失、clock停止或controller锁死。
+
+规则：
+
+- hardware timeout ISR立即停止transfer并wake waiter，不能只清bit后继续等watchdog。
+- hardware timer略短于 NuttX timeout。
+- 不使用CPU loop count模拟时间。
+- command timeout区分 `-ETIMEDOUT` 和 CRC `-EIO`。
+- 首版沿用 AVDK timer count作为起点，但用SDCLK实测校准。
+
+### 5.10 cancel和恢复
+
+CRC fail、timeout、RX overflow、TX underflow、terminal status不一致或watchdog触发时：
+
+1. mask FIFO watermark和data terminal IRQ。
+2. 停止data engine/SDCLK自动发送。
+3. 保存 `last_status`、`remaining` 和command。
+4. 用明确W1C mask清已知status。
+5. 用单一、实测过的 helper复位对应FIFO和SD state。
+6. 清software transfer state和stale semaphore。
+7. wake waiter为 ERROR或TIMEOUT。
+8. 若后续是multiblock，安全状态下发送 CMD12。
+9. 下一command仍失败则reset controller并重新枚举。
+10. power-cycle SD-NAND只作为最后恢复手段。
+
+AVDK register comments对 FIFO/state reset polarity互相矛盾。实施前通过golden register trace或受控FIFO测试确定序列，并只保留一个 `bk7258_sdio_reset_datapath()`。
+
+ISR禁止动态分配、FAT操作、PWC request、busy wait card program或逐watermark日志。
+
+## 6. 4-bit PIO策略
+
+8-pin器件完整引出 DAT0至DAT3且均上拉，电气条件支持4-bit。4-bit与DMA无依赖：AVDK bus width和DMA是独立配置，Host data width也是独立bit。
+
+但本方案不从首版直接启用4-bit，原因是相同clock下byte rate提高4倍，PIO ISR latency要求更高。
+
+启用顺序：
+
+1. 1-bit，6.5/13 MHz，single block稳定。
+2. 1-bit，20 MHz稳定。
+3. 打开 RX/TX watermark IRQ压力测试，确认无overflow/underflow。
+4. capabilities从 `SDIO_CAPS_1BIT_ONLY` 改为 `SDIO_CAPS_4BIT`。
+5. NuttX读取 SCR并发 ACMD6，随后调用 `widebus(true)`。
+6. 4-bit先降到6.5/13 MHz，不同时升频。
+7. 4-bit 20 MHz只在IRQ latency和长稳通过后启用。
+
+`widebus()`只改Host侧data width，card侧ACMD6由MMCSD上层负责。不要复制 AVDK 中 `CONFIG_SDIO_4LINES_EN` 和 `CONFIG_SDCARD_BUSWIDTH_4LINE` 两套symbol分裂，OpenVela使用一个runtime width state。
+
+如果4-bit PIO在系统高负载下出现FIFO错误，正式方案退回1-bit 20 MHz，不以引入未适配DMA来掩盖问题。
+
+## 7. 文件系统和介质布局
+
+### 7.1 SD-NAND作为块设备
+
+软件只看到标准SD sector。1 GB不硬编码sector count，使用CSD和 `BIOC_GEOMETRY`：
+
+```text
+sector size = 512
+capacity = geo_nsectors * 512
+```
+
+商品1 GB可能约1,953,125 sectors，也可能接近2,097,152 sectors。验收以实测geometry、CSD和原厂golden一致为准。
+
+### 7.2 首次只读识别
+
+先读取 sector 0和LBA1：
+
+| 布局 | 识别 | 设备路径 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| FAT superfloppy | sector 0直接是 FAT BPB | `/dev/mmcsd0` |
+| MBR + FAT | MBR entry和`0x55aa` | 注册 `/dev/mmcsd0p0` |
+| GPT + FAT | protective MBR，LBA1 `EFI PART` | 注册 GPT partition |
+| unknown | 无合法结构 | 停止，不写入 |
+
+NuttX MBR partition不会自动注册命名设备。需要时使用 `parse_block_partition()` 和自定义handler：
+
+- `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/fs/partition.h:49-83`
+- `openvela/nuttx/boards/risc-v/mpfs/common/src/mpfs_emmcsd.c:47-79`
+
+### 7.3 FAT
+
+使用 NuttX原生：
+
+```text
+CONFIG_FS_FAT=y
+mount type = vfat
+mount point = /mnt/sdnand
+```
+
+不使用 Armino的 `CONFIG_FATFS`、`bk_fatfs_partition` 或 `FATFS_DEV_SDCARD`。
+
+首轮禁止：
+
+- `mkfatfs`。
+- `dd`写整盘。
+- destructive block test。
+- 自动fsck修复或自动格式化。
+
+只有完成备份、确认设备路径、unmount且产品明确允许后，才单独启用 `CONFIG_FSUTILS_MKFATFS`。
+
+### 7.4 唯一所有权
+
+当前原厂CP不访问SD-NAND，但未来USB device MSC或CP config改变会引入冲突。正式状态机：
+
+```text
+OpenVela owns
+  -> CP SDIO/SDCARD disabled
+  -> USB MSC disabled
+  -> OpenVela may mount
+
+transfer to USB MSC，未来功能
+  -> fsync/sync
+  -> unmount
+  -> stop transfer and verify card not busy
+  -> only then expose block device
+
+return to OpenVela
+  -> USB eject/disconnect
+  -> re-enumerate or media reset
+  -> mount
+```
+
+本阶段不实现USB MSC，不增加跨核storage proxy或owner lock。
+
+### 7.5 掉电
+
+固定NAND可能有内部write cache。`fsync()`只保证请求送到block layer，不证明器件内部掉电安全。
+
+正常关机：
+
+```text
+block new writers
+fsync all files
+sync filesystem
+unmount
+wait active transfer complete
+CMD13/card state确认不busy
+满足datasheet power-off延时
+再关闭VCC rail/系统电源
+```
+
+在没有器件型号和datasheet前，不声称掉电不丢数据。必须执行idle、写入中、fsync后、unmount后四类受控断电测试。
+
+## 8. 目标代码布局
+
+```text
+board/beken/chips/bk7258/
+├── Kconfig
+├── CMakeLists.txt
+├── Make.defs
+├── bk7258_sdio.c
+├── bk7258_sdio.h
+├── include/irq.h
+└── hardware/
+    ├── bk7258_memorymap.h
+    ├── bk7258_sdio.h
+    └── bk7258_sysctrl.h
+
+board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/
+├── include/board.h
+├── src/CMakeLists.txt
+├── src/bk7258_mmcsd.c
+├── src/bk7258_bringup.c
+└── configs/nsh/defconfig
+```
+
+边界：
+
+- chip层：寄存器、IRQ、clock mapping、command、FIFO和 `sdio_dev_s`。
+- board层：GPIO14至GPIO19、VCC rail、电源延时、MMCSD bind和mount。
+- PWC层：CP-compatible clock request及完成等待。
+- 不增加DMA source、DMA section或DMA Kconfig。
+
+## 9. Kconfig/defconfig
+
+### 9.1 chip Kconfig
+
+```kconfig
+config BK7258_SDIO
+	bool "BK7258 SDIO host"
+	select ARCH_HAVE_SDIO
+	select SDIO_BLOCKSETUP
+	help
+		Enable the BK7258 AP SDIO host in interrupt-assisted PIO mode.
+```
+
+不定义 `BK7258_SDIO_DMA`，防止未适配功能被误认为可用。
+
+### 9.2 首版 defconfig
+
+```text
+CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO=y
+
+CONFIG_MMCSD=y
+CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIO=y
+# CONFIG_MMCSD_SPI is not set
+CONFIG_MMCSD_NSLOTS=1
+CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1
+# CONFIG_MMCSD_MMCSUPPORT is not set
+# CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_CARDDETECT is not set
+# CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_WRITEPROTECT is not set
+# CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIOWAIT_WRCOMPLETE is not set
+
+CONFIG_SDIO_BLOCKSETUP=y
+# CONFIG_SDIO_DMA is not set
+# CONFIG_DMA is not set
+
+CONFIG_SCHED_HPWORK=y
+
+CONFIG_FS_FAT=y
+CONFIG_NSH_MMCSDMINOR=0
+
+CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD=y
+CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_ERROR=y
+CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_WARN=y
+CONFIG_DEBUG_MEMCARD_INFO=y
+```
+
+稳定后关闭 INFO，保留 error/warn和driver counters，避免Mailbox日志改变PIO时序。
+
+## 10. 分阶段实施
+
+### P0：原厂golden取证
+
+使用未修改的 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` 原厂AP：
+
+1. 记录CP/AP最终config和ELF SDIO符号，确认只有AP有数据面。
+2. 记录8-pin器件型号、pin-1方向、VCC电压和上电延时。
+3. 记录GPIO14至GPIO19波形和SDCLK。
+4. 导出OCR、CID、CSD、SCR、RCA和容量。
+5. dump sector 0/LBA1，记录文件系统布局。
+6. 备份数据并记录关键文件hash。
+
+退出：硬件pin、电源、容量、布局和golden响应全部固定。
+
+### P1：PWC和Host寄存器
+
+1. 完成SDIO clock request的ACK/completion或readback闭环。
+2. 添加secure base和IRQ26。
+3. 配置GPIO14至GPIO19，内部pull disabled。
+4. 验证ID/transfer clock波形。
+5. 验证reset、W1C和FIFO ready行为。
+
+退出：100次冷启动均能确定开钟成功或有限超时，不随机继续。
+
+### P2：command-only lower-half
+
+实现 reset、clock、attach、sendcmd、waitresponse和responses，按序验证：
+
+```text
+CMD0
+CMD8 R7 = 0x1aa
+CMD55 + ACMD41 OCR ready
+CMD2 CID
+CMD3 RCA
+CMD9 CSD
+CMD7 select
+ACMD51 SCR，进入下一阶段8-byte RX
+```
+
+退出：CID/CSD/OCR与golden一致；断电器件返回有限timeout，无hard fault。
+
+### P3：PIO RX
+
+1. 实现8-byte SCR IRQ RX。
+2. 实现512-byte CMD17。
+3. 验证unaligned destination。
+4. 注册 `/dev/mmcsd0`，只读geometry和sector。
+5. 对比golden sector hash。
+
+退出：连续和随机只读无CRC/overflow，timeout/cancel后可继续命令。
+
+### P4：PIO TX
+
+1. 在备份后的专用测试LBA实现CMD24。
+2. 验证FIFO refill、write-end和response status 2。
+3. pattern写回读：zero、ones、walking bit、PRNG。
+4. 验证unaligned source。
+5. 错误后cancel/reset恢复。
+
+退出：至少10,000次随机单块读写无silent corruption。
+
+### P5：FAT32
+
+1. 根据P0选择whole disk或partition设备。
+2. 首次只读 `vfat` mount `/mnt/sdnand`。
+3. 对比目录、文件长度和hash。
+4. 再执行受控create/write/fsync/read/rename/unlink。
+5. mount/unmount和正常掉电回归。
+
+退出：原数据无损，重新上电和挂载后一致。
+
+### P6：multiblock PIO
+
+1. 解除 `MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1`。
+2. 验证CMD18/CMD25/CMD12和software block count。
+3. 测试2/4/8/32/128 sectors。
+4. 覆盖方向切换、非连续LBA、timeout和CRC恢复。
+
+退出：多块hash一致、无额外块预读泄露、CMD12后card state正确。
+
+### P7：4-bit PIO，可选
+
+按第6节顺序启用，不引入DMA。若20 MHz 4-bit在系统高负载下无法满足FIFO时序，正式退回可靠的1-bit模式。
+
+## 11. 验证矩阵
+
+### 11.1 构建和所有权
+
+- OpenVela `-Werror` CMake构建通过。
+- `all-app.bin`打包和AP binary hash通过。
+- CP config不含SDIO/SDCARD/FATFS/MSC。
+- CP ELF只允许通用vector，不含Host/card实现。
+- OpenVela不链接 `libdriver.a` SDIO object。
+- `.config` 明确 `DMA=n` 和 `SDIO_DMA=n`。
+
+### 11.2 枚举
+
+| 用例 | 预期 |
+| --- | --- |
+| 冷启动100次 | `/dev/mmcsd0`稳定出现 |
+| soft reset | CID/CSD/容量一致 |
+| VCC off | 有限timeout，无死锁 |
+| clock request fail | 不访问Host寄存器 |
+| geometry | sector 512，容量与1 GB器件实测一致 |
+| sector0 | 与golden完全一致 |
+
+### 11.3 PIO
+
+| 用例 | 范围 |
+| --- | --- |
+| SCR | 8 bytes |
+| single read/write | first/middle/last test LBA |
+| alignment | offset 0/1/2/3/4/8/16/32 |
+| random | 10,000次起 |
+| direction | read-write-read循环 |
+| error | command/data timeout、CRC、overflow、cancel |
+| load | Wi-Fi、BT、日志、PWM并发 |
+
+driver必须统计：
+
+```text
+cmd_count, cmd_timeout, cmd_crc_error
+rx_words, tx_words, rx_blocks, tx_blocks
+data_timeout, data_crc_error
+rx_overflow, tx_underflow
+cancel_count, reset_count
+last_cmd, last_status, last_error, last_remaining
+```
+
+### 11.4 FAT和长稳
+
+- 只读mount/list/hash。
+- create/write/fsync/read/rename/unlink。
+- 0-byte、小文件、大文件和空间耗尽。
+- 1000次mount/unmount。
+- 24小时循环IO和hash。
+- 100次冷启动。
+- idle、write中、fsync后、unmount后受控断电。
+
+`cmocka_driver_block` 会破坏约95%介质，只能对备份后的专用测试介质/分区执行，不能对生产FAT卷执行。
+
+### 11.5 性能
+
+记录但不以性能牺牲正确性：
+
+- 1-bit 6.5/13/20 MHz sequential throughput。
+- 4 KiB random IOPS。
+- IRQ rate和单次ISR最大搬运量。
+- CPU utilization和最坏ISR latency。
+- 可选4-bit PIO throughput。
+
+无DMA前提下，性能验收必须包含系统并发负载，不只测空闲系统。
+
+## 12. 完成标准
+
+1. 8-pin pin order、GPIO14至GPIO19和VCC连接有原理图/实测闭环。
+2. 原厂CP最终固件不含SDIO数据路径，后续构建有自动符号检查。
+3. CPU1/OpenVela是唯一Host/sector owner。
+4. PWC clock request有确定完成机制，不使用blind delay。
+5. secure base `0x458d0000`、IRQ26、W1C和reset序列实测正确。
+6. lower-half是NuttX原生IRQ-assisted PIO，不混入Armino RTOS/FATFS。
+7. DMA保持关闭，不上报DMA capability，不存在DMA代码依赖。
+8. `/dev/mmcsd0`稳定枚举，geometry为512-byte sector和真实1 GB容量。
+9. SCR、sector、unaligned buffer、timeout和cancel测试通过。
+10. 单块和多块测试无silent corruption。
+11. 现有FAT32无损挂载，未自动格式化。
+12. 24小时、100次冷启动、1000次mount和掉电测试达到门槛。
+13. 4-bit若启用，必须在无DMA和高系统负载下通过FIFO/CRC长稳；否则交付1-bit。
+14. USB MSC、CP dormant driver和CPU2均不会并发访问介质。
+
+## 13. 待确认事项
+
+| 项目 | 当前状态 | 方法 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| SD-NAND厂商/型号 | 未提供 | 丝印、BOM、datasheet |
+| pin table top/bottom view | pin顺序已知，视图待复核 | datasheet和PCB |
+| VCC电压/rail控制 | 未知 | 原理图和示波器 |
+| power-on/off延时 | 未知 | datasheet |
+| 精确sector count | 未知 | CSD/geometry |
+| superfloppy/MBR/GPT | 未知 | sector0/LBA1 |
+| FIFO threshold单位/深度 | 生成注释不足 | register test和逻辑分析仪 |
+| FIFO/SD reset polarity | 源码注释冲突 | golden trace和受控测试 |
+| conservative clock编码 | 待核对 | enum和SDCLK波形 |
+| PWC completion ABI | OpenVela尚未闭环 | CP handler和抓包 |
+| 4-bit PIO最大可靠频率 | 未知 | 并发压力和SI测试 |
+| SD-NAND内部掉电保证 | 未知 | 器件datasheet和断电测试 |
+
+## 14. 推荐提交顺序
+
+1. `docs: refine BK7258 SDIO PIO porting plan`
+2. `fix: complete AP PWC clock request handshake`
+3. `feat: add BK7258 SDIO command lower-half`
+4. `feat: add BK7258 SDIO IRQ PIO receive path`
+5. `feat: add BK7258 SDIO IRQ PIO transmit path`
+6. `feat: bind BK7258 SD-NAND to MMCSD`
+7. `feat: mount BK7258 SD-NAND FAT volume`
+8. `feat: enable BK7258 SDIO multiblock PIO`
+9. `feat: enable BK7258 SDIO four-bit PIO`
+
+本阶段没有DMA提交。4-bit必须与multiblock分开提交，每个提交包含构建结果和对应实板验证记录。
*** End Patch

+
+# BK7258 OpenVela AP SDIO 与 1 GB SD-NAND 移植设计方案 V2
+
+> 文档状态：结合 8-pin SD-NAND 封装信息、`bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` CP/AP 最终配置和 ELF、BK7258 SDIO V2 PIO 路径、NuttX MMCSD 接口及 BK7236N vendor 目录重新核对后的设计基线。本文是实施方案，不表示驱动已实现或通过实板验收。
+
+## 1. 输入条件和固定结论
+
+### 1.1 已知硬件条件
+
+当前板载介质：
+
+- 容量：1 GB。
+- 封装：8 pin，焊接固定介质，不可热插拔。
+- 接口：标准 SD Memory 信号，器件内部完成 NAND FTL、ECC、坏块管理和磨损均衡。
+- 信号已上拉，OpenVela 不依赖内部 pull-up。
+- 封装 pin 1 至 pin 8 的顺序由用户确认为：
+
+```text
+pin 1  SDD2 / DAT2
+pin 2  CD/SDD3 / DAT3
+pin 3  SCLK
+pin 4  VSS
+pin 5  CMD
+pin 6  SDD0 / DAT0
+pin 7  SDD1 / DAT1
+pin 8  VCC
+```
+
+这里按器件封装 pin table 解释，不套用 microSD 卡座触点编号。标准 microSD 的 pin 3 是 CMD、pin 5 是 CLK，与本器件提供的封装顺序不同；PCB、器件 top/bottom view 和 pin-1 标记仍应在首次上电前复核，避免把卡座编号误用于焊接封装。
+
+`CD/SDD3` 是 SD 协议中的 DAT3/上电 card-detect 复用信号，不是独立机械插卡检测脚。该器件固定焊接，因此 NuttX 不启用 card-detect GPIO。
+
+### 1.2 器件引脚到 BK7258 的连接
+
+`bk_solution_ai` 板型使用 BK7258 GPIO14 至 GPIO19：
+
+| SD-NAND pin | SD 信号 | BK7258 GPIO | BK GPIO function | 首版 |
+| ---: | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
+| 1 | DAT2 | GPIO18 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA2` | 保持 SDIO/上拉，1-bit 不传数据 |
+| 2 | DAT3 | GPIO19 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA3` | 保持 SDIO/上拉，1-bit 不传数据 |
+| 3 | CLK | GPIO14 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_CLK` | 使用 |
+| 4 | VSS | GND | - | 使用 |
+| 5 | CMD | GPIO15 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_CMD` | 使用 |
+| 6 | DAT0 | GPIO16 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA0` | 使用 |
+| 7 | DAT1 | GPIO17 | `GPIO_DEV_SDIO_HOST_DATA1` | 保持 SDIO/上拉，1-bit 不传数据 |
+| 8 | VCC | 3.3 V rail，待原理图确认控制方式 | - | 使用 |
+
+依据：
+
+- `bk_solution_ai/projects/beken_genie/ap/config/bk7258_ap/usr_gpio_cfg.h:36-41`
+- `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:42-47`
+
+首版虽然只使用 DAT0 传输，仍不得把 DAT1、DAT2、DAT3 复用给 PWM、LCD 或其他外设。SD 协议上电和切换 4-bit 时需要这些线保持合法电平；当前硬件已外部上拉，软件将其配置为 SDIO function/input，不额外开启内部 pull-up，避免改变电气参数。
+
+### 1.3 软件约束
+
+- 当前 OpenVela AP 已完成单核启动、日志、GPIO 和 PWM。
+- 当前 OpenVela AP 没有 DMA 外设适配。
+- 本方案固定为 PIO-only，不新增、包装或启用 Armino GDMA。
+- `CONFIG_DMA`、`CONFIG_SDIO_DMA` 和 BK7258 SDIO DMA capability 保持关闭。
+- 4-bit 与 DMA 在硬件上相互独立，但本方案只在 1-bit PIO 稳定后评估 4-bit PIO。
+- CPU1/OpenVela AP 是 SDIO Host 和 SD-NAND 数据路径唯一所有者。
+- CPU0/CP 继续运行原厂固件，只提供既有 PWC/PM 中央时钟门控服务。
+- CPU2 不访问 SDIO。
+
+### 1.4 固定软件架构
+
+```text
+OpenVela application / NSH
+          |
+          v
+NuttX FAT filesystem，vfat
+          |
+          v
+/dev/mmcsd0 或 /dev/mmcsd0p0
+          |
+          v
+NuttX drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c
+          |
+          | struct sdio_dev_s
+          v
+BK7258 SDIO lower-half，CPU1/AP，IRQ-assisted PIO
+          |
+          | GPIO14 CLK, GPIO15 CMD, GPIO16..19 DAT0..3
+          v
+板载 1 GB 8-pin SD-NAND
+
+CPU0/原厂 CP
+          |
+          `-- PWC/PM clock gate only，不读写 sector
+```
+
+### 1.5 首版参数
+
+| 项目 | 首版设置 |
+| --- | --- |
+| 介质 | 固定 present，无 hotplug/write-protect |
+| 协议 | SD Memory，关闭 MMC/eMMC support |
+| 总线 | 1-bit，CLK/CMD/DAT0 |
+| ID clock | BK 编码 7，约 101.5625 kHz |
+| transfer clock | 先 6.5 或 13 MHz，稳定后验证 20 MHz |
+| 数据路径 | RX/TX FIFO 水位 IRQ 驱动 PIO |
+| sector | 512 bytes |
+| multi-block | 首版限制为 1 block/request |
+| DMA | 明确关闭，不在本方案范围 |
+| 文件系统 | 先只读识别现有 FAT32 |
+| 设备节点 | `/dev/mmcsd0` |
+| 自动格式化 | 禁止 |
+
+AVDK 已在 1-bit PIO 下使用 20 MHz，但 NuttX lower-half 的 IRQ 水位搬运模型与 AVDK 线程轮询模型不同。为避免首版 ISR latency 造成 FIFO overflow/underflow，先以 6.5 或 13 MHz 验证，之后再升到 20 MHz。
+
+### 1.6 不采用的方案
+
+- 不使用 MTD、raw NAND、page/OOB、软件 ECC 或软件 FTL。
+- 不把 Armino `sd_card_driver.c` 直接注册为 NuttX 块设备。
+- 不链接 BK7236N 或 BK7258 Armino `libdriver.a` 的 SDIO 实现。
+- 不修改原厂 CP 固件来代理 sector/file IO。
+- 不让 CP、AP、USB MSC 同时访问同一介质。
+- 不启用 DMA，不增加 DMA stub，不上报 `SDIO_CAPS_DMASUPPORTED`。
+- 不照搬 AVDK 在线程中轮询 512-byte FIFO 的 RTOS semaphore 模型。
+- 不首轮启用 multiblock、4-bit、自动断电、热插拔或自动格式化。
+

+

+生成的 CP `sdkconfig.h` 到文件末尾也没有这些宏：

+依据：

+- `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:179-185`

+- 没有 `bk_sdio_host_driver_init`、`bk_sdio_host_*`、`bk_sd_card_init`、`bk_sd_card_read_blocks` 或 `bk_sd_card_write_blocks` 实现符号。

+因此，“CP 源码树存在 SDIO/SD card 代码”不能解释为“当前原厂 CP 固件访问 SD-NAND”。这些是 dormant source，只有显式打开 CP 的 `CONFIG_SDIO_HOST`/`CONFIG_SDCARD` 后才可能参与构建。

+### 2.3 CP 仍参与中央时钟管理
+
+AP 对 `CLK_PWR_ID_SDIO` 的开关请求通过 PM Mailbox 交给 CP；CP 执行中央 clock gate 寄存器写。这是“控制面服务”，不是“存储数据访问”。

+### 2.4 CP dormant code 的防回归要求
+
+后续每次替换 CP 固件或修改其 config，都必须检查：

+CONFIG_SDIO_HOST is not set
+CONFIG_SDCARD is not set
+CONFIG_FATFS_SDCARD is not set
+CONFIG_USBD_MSC is not set
+```
